mapper.select: select * from mall_payment where order_id=#{orderId} and member_id=#{memberId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select * from mall_payment where payment_no=#{paymentNo} for update
select * from mall_payment where payment_id=#{paymentId} for update
select * from mall_payment where order_id=#{orderId} and status='SUCCESS' order by payment_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update mall_payment set status=#{status},provider_payment_no=#{providerPaymentNo},payment_url=#{paymentUrl}, failure_reason=#{failureReason},update_time=now() where payment_id=#{paymentId} and status='CREATING'
update mall_payment set status='SUCCESS',paid_time=now(),update_time=now() where payment_id=#{paymentId} and status='PAYING'
update mall_payment set status='CLOSED',failure_reason='支付结果等待超时',update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status in ('CREATING','PAYING')
update mall_payment set status='REFUNDING',paid_time=now(),failure_reason='订单关闭后收到支付成功结果', update_time=now() where payment_id=#{paymentId} and status in ('CLOSED','PAYING')
update mall_payment set status='REFUNDED',provider_refund_no=#{providerRefundNo},refund_time=now(), update_time=now() where payment_id=#{paymentId} and status='REFUNDING'
